pages.title: Theory of Everything
pages.text: The Standard Model, quantum mechanics, relativity, string theory, grand unification and M-theory written as one equation. It is short, symmetric and almost embarrassingly simple, and it describes every interaction there is. Holding it, nothing feels mysterious, briefly.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Compressor the singularities of the Standard Model, spacetime, quantum mechanics and the extra dimensions, plus the unified cores. The theories merged. What remained fit on a single line.
